item.title: Limits of Independent Security Verification on Vendor-Locked Devices
item.description: Vendor-locked devices, most prominently stock Android phones with a locked bootloader and no administrator access, are general-purpose computers whose owners are nonetheless structurally prevented from fully inspecting, controlling, or verifying the software running on their own device.
